entities.name: House Scarlet
entities.description: One of five powerful houses in Arathoxia, also called House Ruby, ruled by Adam Carthalion and then the Scarlet Vizier.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Lord of House Scarlet; his death left the house to the Scarlet Vizier.

entities.name: Scarlet Vizier
entities.description: Ruler of House Scarlet after Adam's death, ward-keeper of Liana; killed in Ravidel's invasion.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Ward of the Scarlet Vizier who came to possess the red Mox.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Stole the Moxes, used them to activate the Mox Beacon, invaded Arathoxia and took Castle Melmereth.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: Device activated with the stolen Moxes.

entities.name: Planar Barge
entities.description: Its blast obliterated the Scarlet Estate.

entities.name: Scarlet Estate
entities.description: House Scarlet's estate in Arathoxia, obliterated.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Adam's son, true Lord of the house, who led the attack on Castle Melmereth.

entities.name: Castle Melmereth
entities.description: House Scarlet's seat of power north of Arathoxia, taken by Ravidel and destroyed.

entities.name: House Carthalion
entities.description: House Jared brought through the Planeswalker War.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: War that followed the destruction of Castle Melmereth.

events.summary: Ravidel steals the Moxes and uses them to activate the Mox Beacon.
events.quote: The Moxes were later stolen by Ravidel and used to activate the Mox Beacon

events.summary: The Scarlet Vizier is killed in Ravidel's invasion and the Scarlet Estate is obliterated by a blast from the Planar Barge.
events.quote: The Scarlet Vizier was killed in Ravidel’s invasion of the city

events.summary: Jared Carthalion and his allies attack Castle Melmereth, destroying it and ending House Scarlet's presence.
events.quote: Jared Carthalion and his allies attacked the castle, and it too was destroyed

relations.quote: ruled by Lord Adam Carthalion , and after his death, the Scarlet Vizier
